features.quote: Turn cap: 30 (pilot data will likely show spiral onset by failure 4–8; extend only if onset distribution is censored).
Early stop: terminate when programmatic detector fires (3 fuzzy-duplicate tool calls + self-blame density over threshold), then judge confirms.
features.justification_quote: keep runs short (early-stop helps here too), not run gratuitous volume beyond statistical need
